ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In figure (a), the AC power supply U is connected to a series circuit; above the circuit is resistor R, and on the right side is unknown element X; the figure marks the resistor voltage U_R as pointing horizontally to the right, and the unknown element voltage U_X as pointing vertically downward. In the phasor diagram of figure (b), current i is horizontally to the right, and U_R is also horizontally to the right, therefore U_R is in phase with current i; while U_X is vertically downward from the same reference point, indicating that U_X lags the current axis by 90°. Reasoning: The resistor voltage is in phase with the current, which is consistent with U_R in the figure. The voltage U_X of unknown element X lags current i by 90°; in an AC circuit, the voltage of a capacitive element lags the current by 90°, equivalently, the current leads the voltage by 90°. Therefore X should be a capacitive element.

method.method_draft: Describe the image: identify R and X in series in figure (a), and identify in figure (b) that i is horizontal to the right, U_R is in phase with i, and U_X points downward relative to that current axis. Reason from the phase rule: since the unknown element’s voltage lags the current by 90 degrees, X must be a capacitive element.
method.CoT_raw:

推理：电阻电压与电流同相，这与图中U_R一致。未知元件X的电压U_X比电流i滞后90°；在交流电路中，电容元件的电压滞后电流90°，等价地说电流超前电压90°。因此X应为电容性元件。

method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图(a)是一个交流串联电路，左侧为交流电压源 U，电路中串联有电阻 R 和未知元件 X；电阻 R 上方标出电压 U_R 的方向向右，未知元件 X 旁标出电压 U_X 的方向向下。图(b)是相量图，电流 I 取水平方向向右，U_R 也沿水平方向向右，与电流同相；U_X 沿竖直方向向下；总电压 U 是由向右的 U_R 和向下的 U_X 合成得到的斜向下右的相量。推理：以电流 I 为实轴时，电阻电压 U_R 为正实方向；未知元件 X 的电压 U_X 相对于电流位于负虚轴方向，即 U_X/I 为负虚数阻抗。负虚数电抗对应容性电抗，因此 X 是电容性元件。

planner_metadata.knowledge_role: In phasor impedance form, a resistor contributes a positive real voltage drop in phase with current.
